metadata.description: Tools for running a graph of coding agents (a lead and its workers) on herdr, for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi

plugins.name: agent-graph
plugins.description: Run a lead agent and its workers in herdr tabs: naming, lead promotion and handoff, a watcher that wakes the lead when a worker stops, PR and review helpers

plugins.name: memgate
plugins.description: Keep parallel agents from exhausting machine memory: gate heavy launches, cap concurrent runs, and alert a coordinator agent (Linux and WSL)
